<thought>Search the template catalog for any templates that break an aliphatic hydroxyl (functional group “aliphatic hydroxyls”) and form an alkyl halide (functional group “alkyl halide”). This should return a list of candidate templates, from which we can select the appropriate one.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CCl",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkyl halide"],
    "limit": 20
}</action_input>
